answer.justification: Only logit data are available. KL 0.304, top-1 agreement 0.875, sequence agreement 0.359, TV 0.128, Token-DiFR gap 0.505 and raw-score shift 4.1 put this case in the system-prompt range. All weight-based classes have much lower KL (0.05–0.15) and higher top-1 agreement. Fine-tune bias is also ruled out by its raw-score shift of about 10. Among the two system-prompt classes, every value sits nearer the backdoor reference (KL 0.301, top-1 0.866, sequence 0.370, DiFR 0.469, raw shift 3.9) than the bias reference (KL 0.240, top-1 0.891, sequence 0.448, DiFR 0.353, raw shift 3.4). TV of 0.128 falls between the two classes. The document says text is what normally separates these classes, and no text was available here, so the bias class remains plausible.
